claim_text: On August 15, forecasters warned that Lala, then a tropical storm hitting the Big Island with heavy rain and strong winds, could strengthen into a hurricane.
quote: Tropical Storm Lala brought heavy rain and strong winds to Hawaii’s Big Island as forecasters warned it could become a hurricane.
confidence_justification: A forecast attributed to identified forecasters and a prediction rather than a settled fact; the August 16 reports confirm the storm did reach hurricane strength, but this claim records the August 15 warning only.
